title.zh: CloudForge · 基于 Cloudflare 的自托管 Git 与代码审查服务
title.en: CloudForge · Self-Hosted Git & Code Review on Cloudflare

summary.zh: 跑在自己 Cloudflare 账户里的单租户 Git 托管服务，包含 Git HTTPS/LFS 仓库、堆叠 PR、容器 CI 和 AI 辅助代码审查功能。
summary.en: Single-tenant Git hosting service running on Cloudflare Workers, D1, Artifacts, and Containers, supporting Git HTTPS/LFS, stacked PRs, container CI, and AI-assisted code review.

zh: 使用 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Artifacts 实现 Git HTTPS 与 Git LFS 仓库读写，无需单独购买常驻服务器
支持按安全、数据、性能等维度运行 AI 代码审查，并可在收件箱里人工确认或驳回审查建议
内置堆叠 PR（Stacked PRs）依赖展示、Cloudflare Containers 工作流执行与 OAuth MCP 接口
en: Git HTTPS and Git LFS hosting backed by Cloudflare Workers, D1, and Artifacts
Role-based AI code review with a human review inbox for accepting or dismissing findings
Stacked PR dependency tracking, Cloudflare Containers workflow runner, and OAuth MCP endpoint

milestone.zh: 已完成代码审查流、容器 CI、OAuth MCP 与中英文档站，后续按日常使用需求修补。
milestone.en: Review workflow, container CI, OAuth MCP, and bilingual docs are in place; maintained as needed.
